experiment: Legacy metric re-evaluation: expert reconstruction vs actual aggregated MoE-layer output error
nature: retrospective, evaluation-only metric audit; not a new calibration method

gptq.capture: CANONICAL-B1 (each calibration sequence forwarded alone, BF16, non-sequential)

not_evaluated: Coverage-LP-Repr (no saved weights; would need new capture + quantization)

comparisons.ebss: EBSS vs FR_s0/s1/s2 and vs TR_s0/s1/s2 (one released set; three comparisons are NOT replications)
comparisons.b16_exploratory: PX_EBSS16, PX_PO16, RS_EBSS16, RS_PO16 vs C4R16_s0 (matched) and vs C4R16 seed range; never ranked with B=128

confirm.note: locked document-disjoint confirmation split (runs_aggregate_constraint); never used for selection; previously used once to score expert reconstruction of FR/TR/TC/FC built from the batch-8 historical cache, never for MoE-output error

oldtest.note: historical E3 test rows 2128-2255; inspected in many prior studies; exploratory

evaluation.inputs: frozen BF16 layer inputs of each split's cache (identical for every method); routing, top-4, coefficients and shared expert from the BF16 model, never from a quantized model
evaluation.primary_metric: E_layer per layer = sum_x ||y_BF16 - y_q||^2 / (sum_x ||y_BF16||^2 + 1e-30), fp32 expert math, float64 sums, shared expert included in y, frozen routing (the AGQ-only validation's LayerEvalAccumulator definition)
evaluation.aggregate: MEAN of the four per-layer ratios (AGQ-only convention); a pooled ratio is stored in json for reference only and is not used for any decision
evaluation.relative_difference: Delta = (E^method - E^ref) / E^ref of the 4-layer mean (negative = method better)
evaluation.secondary_metric: E_expert = production E3 score (quant_eval.per_seq_rel_errors on Profiler held-out inputs, mean over sequences per expert, mean over 240 experts) on the INSTALLED BF16 weights (the weights the layer metric uses); historical E3 (solver fp32 W_q, oldtest) is reported alongside
evaluation.native_check: actual Qwen2MoeSparseMoeBlock BF16 forward with installed weights (secondary)
evaluation.decomposition: ||dy||^2 = D + C, D = sum_k ||c_k dE_k||^2, C = 2 sum_{a<b} <c_a dE_a, c_b dE_b>; each divided by the same layer denominator
evaluation.uncertainty: seed-level paired effects (3 seeds); descriptive paired window bootstrap (2000 reps, windows resampled jointly across layers and methods). Experts and tokens are NOT treated as independent replicates.

decision_rule.legacy_direction: from E_expert on the same split: 'penalty' if mean Delta_expert >= +tau and Delta_expert > 0 on >= 2/3 seeds; 'gain' mirror; otherwise 'tie'

when_legacy_penalty.LEGACY-NEGATIVE-CONFIRMED (A): Delta_layer > 0 on >= 2/3 seeds, no seed <= -tau, and mean Delta_layer >= max(tau, 0.5 * mean Delta_expert)
when_legacy_penalty.METRIC-ALIGNED-BUT-SMALL (D): Delta_layer > 0 on >= 2/3 seeds, no seed <= -tau, but mean Delta_layer < max(tau, 0.5 * mean Delta_expert)

decision_rule.layer_specific_flag: a layer whose Delta_layer has the opposite sign to the 4-layer mean on every paired seed with |Delta| >= tau is reported as a layer-specific reversal
decision_rule.evaluation_blocked: EVALUATION-BLOCKED (E) if any correctness gate fails or required weights are missing
decision_rule.single_set: EBSS / B16 single sets are classified with the same rule over their comparisons but labelled 'one calibration set, not replicated'
decision_rule.decision_split: classifications on the PRIMARY split decide; secondary-split disagreement is reported

final_recommendation.A: FC-vs-FR is B, or TC-vs-TR is NEW-METRIC-GAIN / B
final_recommendation.B: FC-vs-FR is A or D, TC-vs-TR is not a gain, and EBSS-vs-FR is not a gain

regression.note: historical references used only as regression checks after confirming identical universe

hard_constraints: no new PPL experiment (quant_config's built-in PPL validity check runs for TC and is reported only as a byproduct)
